rv.q: The musical, even at this somewhat wobbly preliminary stage, holds on to the gold of Hinton's novel, transmuting it imperfectly yet courageously into hypnotic theater.
For the hopeless, for the loveless, for the misunderstood, which is all of us, Greaser and Soc, young and old, “The Outsiders” offers the promise of harmony.
Well, happy to report that The Outsiders shines through in a thrilling adaptation.
It successfully blends the best of the book and the movie in a richly detailed story for teen and adult audiences.

cn.t: A respectable adaptation of the beloved novel that captures its dark emotional power through strong musical performances and staging, though it occasionally struggles to transcend the source material's adolescent earnestness.
